paraphrase: Absorbed in one's work (kāyaka), one must forget even the sight of the guru and even liṅga-worship, and must break off even if a jaṅgama stands before one; because work is Kailāsa, even Amarēśvaraliṅga is within work.
speaker: Āydakki Mārayya
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D. The phrase 'kāyakavē kailāsa' (work is heaven) is popularly ascribed to Basava; the recalled vacana is Āydakki Mārayya's — confirm.
